issue_context.title: Refine batchCop in disaggregated tiflash mode

review_comments: Delete this if branch because there will be no batchCop protocol in disaggregated tiflash mode. Also mpp error handling will be handled in `mpp.go`
will this start too many goroutines?
Normally the max number of tiflash will not be greater than 100.

In [(ss *RegionBatchRequestSender) SendReqToAddr](https://github.com/guo-shaoge/tidb/blob/bd76d19d9cfd1310af64217fa17bf2f6a53b3a7a/store/copr/batch_request_sender.go#L80), will check err and set RPCError. Also the returned err will be changed to nil if `onSendFailForBatchRegions` succeed.
